title: Pocketwire Business Profile Refund Terms Schedule
content:
Schedule to the refund terms of the Pocketwire Business Profile. The refund window is the number of calendar days after the sale date within which the seller can refund the buyer through Pocketwire. The fee-credit row states whether the percentage part of the transaction fee is returned in proportion when a sale is refunded; the fixed part of the fee is never returned. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Refund window (calendar days after the sale date) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Percentage part of the transaction fee credited back on a refund | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

The tiers that credit part of the transaction fee back on refunds are therefore Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise; on Pocketwire Business Starter and Pocketwire Business Essentials no fee is credited back on a refund.
